basic_info.description: Marina District Magic at 41-43 Mallora Way. When it comes to real estate, few addresses whisper quintessential San Francisco lifestyle quite like Mallorca & Chestnut. Positioned on this iconic corner, 41-43 Mallorca is not just a residence, it's a rare opportunity for next-generation luxury living. This dramatic Mediterranean two-unit building blends architectural charm with future-forward potential. With expansive lower-level storage, this building is ready for reimagining!  Think creating a luxe 2-level lower unit or sunlit ADU.  The possibilities are as bold as your vision. Ideal for 'any-age'-somethings craving style and space with friends. Each unit offers privacy and classic detailing, while a west-facing yard serves as your private outdoor lounge, almost all day in the sun. For discerning parents helping their kids build generational wealth, this is Marina investment at its smartest: location, expansion upside, and timeless architecture. Elevate with new kitchens and baths or keep the vintage character intact. 41-43 Mallorca isn't just a place to live. It's where legacies begin.
